claim.summary: Binary Boolean Gamma on v variables, generators degree<=w,1 notin C_D. For any r affine forms with independent linear parts, if B=D-r>=max(2,w), some fibre of free dimension n=v-r preserves PC hardness through B. Its selector chi_b has degree<=r and survives C_D; a fibre refutation would derive chi_b through B+r. Affine elimination preserves degree-B refutability both ways and does not increase joint degree of a complete ENS source when fresh coefficients are fixed. The guaranteed deficit is n/2-B=(v/2-D)+r/2. This is a limitation of the generic selector guarantee, not an upper bound on actual fibre hardness or a rejection of specially chosen slices.
claim.assessment: Working composition of the imported affine free-dimension mechanism with the existing pattern-selector replay; full elementary proof and sole medium review. No new near-half family or new Frege-chain certification.

formalization.scope: Informal proof or computation; no Lean verification.

significance.rationale: Makes exact the distinction between removing existing affine axioms for free and imposing new affine constraints at the selector hardness cost. Generic slicing cannot improve the certified near-half ratio.
significance.next_action: Use auxiliary-affine normalization only with a stronger actual hardness-preservation theorem or a family proved hard directly on the selected slice; retain the source-dependent problem.

claim.summary: Single-constraint dichotomy: for any Boolean base B (PHP axioms unused) and fixed forms L, one constraint forbidding F != F_p^k on affine forms L, hardness of B+{L=v} at degree E for one allowed v gives hardness of B+constraint at degree E; a refutation of B+{L=v} at degree E' gives B |- chi_v(L)=0 at degree E'+(p-1)k, so the constraint forbidding all other patterns (density 1-p^-k) is refuted. Density plays no role for one constraint; refinement of the recorded retained affine-conditioning corollary.
claim.assessment: Working proof by substitution and multiplication by the pattern indicator; ties the one-constraint core statement to the wide-conditioning conjecture up to (p-1)k degrees; same Fermat-selector mechanism as cor:retained-affine-conditioning-gap.

significance.rationale: Shows density is irrelevant for one constraint; hardness is wide conditioning of a pattern.

claim.summary: Let J2 be a binary degree-D pseudoideal containing old Booleanity, J_E its scalar extension, Phi fix old variables and send fresh binary variables to old E-polynomials of degree<=T, and W survive with degree<=b. For T>=1,B>=2,b+TB<=D, if W Phi(F) lies in J_E for every binary source polynomial of degree<=B in a family containing every fresh field equation, then binary maps of degree<=T and a binary surviving weight of degree<=b satisfy the same weighted source relations. At any one cutoff k with b+k<=D, the weight can retain at least half the original multiplication rank. E may be any finite extension or the algebraic closure of F2.
claim.assessment: Working complete proof passed by one medium reviewer. Weighted a^2-a identities imply W(sigma^i a-a) by repeated degree-b+2T Frobenius reuse; a unital trace projection replaces all coefficient images within the weighted annihilator. Original-degree monomial telescoping handles the nonlinear source before coefficient-component descent of W. Pang v1 Lemma3.1 selects a binary combination retaining half rank, with no extension-degree loss. Applies to the binary one-hot pullback of the charged quotient, not to non-Boolean Fourier variables as old Boolean variables. Provides pseudoideal memberships and preserves the original b+TB replay/cofactor budget; no smaller ordinary NS certificates or new source-map existence is asserted. Exhaustive GF8 joint-map controls and rank/missing-field controls pass.

formalization.scope: Informal proof or computation; no Lean verification.

significance.rationale: A degree-exact legal-field reduction for jointly chosen weighted source maps, extending the scope beyond fixed binary kernels. Allows algebraic-closure searches for this sufficient endpoint; no quantitative nonlinear source bound or independent novelty claim.
significance.next_action: In the scheduled architecture review, test whether a source-specific algebraic-closure incidence argument can prove nonemptiness with a surviving weight, retaining all complete field equations and original degree costs.
